name: Oracle - Sys Audit Log
description: See information derived from the syslog audit trail, including successful and failed activities, and top usage by client, database user, and privileges used.
title: Oracle - Sys Audit Log

queries.queryString:
db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message "
LENGTH : '*'
ACTION :[*] '*'
DATABASE USER:[*] '*'
PRIVILEGE :[*] '*'
CLIENT USER:[*] '*'
CLIENT TERMINAL:[*] '*'
STATUS:[*] '*'
DBID:[*] '*'" as totallength, actionlength, Action, databaseuserlength, databaseUser, privilegelength, privilege, clientuserlength, clientUser, clientterminallength, clientTerminal, statuslength, status, dbidlength, dbid
| count as eventCount by privilege
| top 10 privilege by eventCount, privilege asc

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle !"STATUS:[1] '0'" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message "
LENGTH : '*'
ACTION :[*] '*'
DATABASE USER:[*] '*'
PRIVILEGE :[*] '*'
CLIENT USER:[*] '*'
CLIENT TERMINAL:[*] '*'
STATUS:[*] '*'
DBID:[*] '*'" as totallength, actionlength, Action, databaseuserlength, databaseUser, privilegelength, privilege, clientuserlength, clientUser, clientterminallength, clientTerminal, statuslength, status, dbidlength, dbid
| where status!="0"
| timeslice 1s
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, Action, databaseUser, privilege, clientUser, clientTerminal, status, dbid
| sort by _timeslice | fields -eventCount
| limit 20
